These fixtures are analyzed statically; no specimen or command is executed.
Run `python3 testdata/triage/stranded-current/check.py` from the checkout.

The Perl cases distinguish the query scalar from an unrelated fixed command,
and the captured result array from a different or reassigned array. Console
output alone is a neutral stream capability. The PE is the existing synthetic
Mettle import fixture with its source-path marker appended and the package
member name `bin/mettle.exe`; that packaging must not suppress its C2 finding.

The full member review is recorded in
`triage-reports/stranded-current-2026-10-18.json`. All 103 available members
received individual before/after scans, facts and verdict markers. The 15
GoAhead system templates retain empty command buffers and are BENIGN; the
bind/reverse libraries implement shell channels. The two named Ruby members
are absent from the supplied Debian archive and remain unjudged.

The procfs path composite preserves its matcher and platform/type scope, but
now reports references rather than credential dumping. Its explicit consumer
uses the new ID; broad credential selectors intentionally lose this neutral
observation. The Perl parameter accessor likewise preserves matching scope and
moves to HTTP CGI, with its exact consumer updated. VNC consumers use the new
reflective-loading ID. No unrelated leaf was split to satisfy a rule budget.

The two preload API-set composites remain in their capability homes at notable:
imports and a loader-variable reference establish no hostile command. Mettle
C2 source markers remain notable; they do not establish a runnable implant.
The final repository gate is `make validate`.
